{{dablink|For other uses of the word "winter," see [[Winter]].}}
The '''Great Winter War''' is a conflict fought between the kingdoms of [[Andor]] and [[Cairhien]], beginning in late {{ne|671}} and presumably extending into at least the [[672 NE|following year]].

The causes of the war and how it was resolved are unknown at this time. The war is one of several that is taught by [[Aes Sedai]] in [[Brown Ajah]] history lessons to novices and [[Accepted]] in the [[White Tower]].
